preconditions.description: Number of levels in the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= n for t, l, r, x in operations if operations[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: Level t is within the valid range for operations of type 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= l <= r <= cnt[t] for t, l, r, x in operations if operations[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: Range [l, r] is within the valid range for operations of type 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= 10**6 for t, l, r, x in operations if operations[0] == '1')
preconditions.description: Value x is within the valid range for operations of type 1.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= n for t, v in operations if operations[0] == '2')
preconditions.description: Level t is within the valid range for operations of type 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= cnt[t] for t, v in operations if operations[0] == '2')
preconditions.description: Position v is within the valid range for operations of type 2.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(result, int) for result in results)
all(0 <= result <= 10**6 for result in results)
postconditions.description: Each result is within the valid range.
